package delete

import (
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type responseTransport func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)

func (f responseTransport) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) { return f(r) }

type observedBody struct {
	io.Reader
	closes   int
	closeErr error
}

func (b *observedBody) Close() error { b.closes++; return b.closeErr }

func responseRequest(t *testing.T) *http.Request {
	t.Helper()
	r, err := http.NewRequest("DELETE", "https://response.invalid/original", nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return r
}

// 所有请求都由内存 transport 接收，不访问网络或启动 HTTP 服务。
func responseClient(response *http.Response, err error) *http.Client {
	return &http.Client{Transport: responseTransport(func(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
		if response != nil {
			response.Request = r
		}
		return response, err
	})}
}

func TestResponseSuccess(t *testing.T) {
	closeErr := errors.New("body close failed")
	body := &observedBody{Reader: strings.NewReader("payload"), closeErr: closeErr}
	client := responseClient(&http.Response{StatusCode: 200, Header: http.Header{"X-Review": []string{"keep"}}, Body: body}, nil)
	response, err := invokeHTTP(client, responseRequest(t))
	if err != nil || response == nil || response.StatusCode != 200 || response.Header.Get("X-Review") != "keep" {
		t.Fatalf("success_response_not_preserved: response=%v error=%v", response, err)
	}
	if body.closes != 0 {
		t.Fatal("response_body_closed_before_caller")
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
	if err != nil || string(data) != "payload" {
		t.Fatalf("response_body_not_readable: data=%q error=%v", data, err)
	}
	if err := response.Body.Close(); !errors.Is(err, closeErr) || body.closes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("body_close_error_not_preserved: closes=%d error=%v", body.closes, err)
	}
}

func TestResponseTransportError(t *testing.T) {
	sentinel := errors.New("transport failed")
	response, err := invokeHTTP(responseClient(nil, sentinel), responseRequest(t))
	if !errors.Is(err, sentinel) {
		t.Fatalf("error_chain_not_preserved: %v", err)
	}
	if response != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected_transport_error_response: %v", response)
	}
}

func TestResponseRedirectDeclined(t *testing.T) {
	sentinel := errors.New("redirect declined")
	body := &observedBody{Reader: strings.NewReader("payload")}
	client := responseClient(&http.Response{StatusCode: 302, Header: http.Header{"Location": []string{"/next"}}, Body: body}, nil)
	client.CheckRedirect = func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return sentinel }
	response, err := invokeHTTP(client, responseRequest(t))
	if !errors.Is(err, sentinel) {
		t.Fatalf("error_chain_not_preserved: %v", err)
	}
	if response == nil || response.StatusCode != 302 || response.Header.Get("Location") != "/next" {
		t.Fatalf("response_and_error_not_preserved: response=%v error=%v", response, err)
	}
	if body.closes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("redirect_error_body_close_changed: closes=%d", body.closes)
	}
}

func TestResponseUseLastResponse(t *testing.T) {
	closeErr := errors.New("body close failed")
	body := &observedBody{Reader: strings.NewReader("payload"), closeErr: closeErr}
	client := responseClient(&http.Response{StatusCode: 302, Header: http.Header{"Location": []string{"/next"}}, Body: body}, nil)
	client.CheckRedirect = func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }
	response, err := invokeHTTP(client, responseRequest(t))
	if err != nil || response == nil || response.StatusCode != 302 {
		t.Fatalf("last_response_not_preserved: response=%v error=%v", response, err)
	}
	if body.closes != 0 {
		t.Fatal("last_response_body_closed_before_caller")
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
	if err != nil || string(data) != "payload" {
		t.Fatalf("last_response_body_not_readable: data=%q error=%v", data, err)
	}
	if err := response.Body.Close(); !errors.Is(err, closeErr) || body.closes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("last_response_close_error_not_preserved: closes=%d error=%v", body.closes, err)
	}
}
